privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We're finishing the full policy text. Here's a short summary of what we store and why.

sections.title: What we store
sections.text: Your display name, class and level, interface language, year of birth, and your practice history: tasks, your answers and results.

sections.title: Artificial intelligence
sections.text: Task texts and wrong answers may be sent to an AI provider to generate new tasks and explain mistakes — without your name or e-mail.

sections.title: Minors
sections.text: If you are under 16, your practice history is only stored once a parent or guardian confirms by e-mail.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You can download your data or delete your account at any time from the profile settings.
